description: This file defines the core Smarty class, which is the main component of the Smarty template engine. It includes configuration, directory management, plugin loading, security, and template object creation functionalities.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: The main Smarty class, responsible for managing template directories, caching, security, plugins, and creating template objects.

methods.name: addTemplateDir
methods.description: Adds template directory(s) to the Smarty configuration.

methods.name: setTemplateDir
methods.description: Sets the template directory(s), overwriting existing entries.

methods.name: getTemplateDir
methods.description: Returns the current template directory or a specific entry.

methods.name: getConfigDir
methods.description: Returns the current configuration directory or a specific entry.

methods.name: getPluginsDir
methods.description: Retrieves the list of plugin directories.

methods.name: setCompileDir
methods.description: Sets the directory for compiled templates.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new template object based on specified resource.

methods.name: loadPlugin
methods.description: Dynamically loads a plugin class file.

methods.name: _getTemplateId
methods.description: Generates a unique template identifier based on resource and cache/compile IDs.

methods.name: _normalizeDir
methods.description: Normalizes and sets directory paths for cache, compile, or plugin directories.

methods.name: _normalizeTemplateConfig
methods.description: Normalizes template or config directory paths and flags.
